# Data Source: tfe_registry_gpg_keys

Gets all private registry GPG keys of an organization.

## Example Usage

```python
import constructs as constructs
import cdktf as cdktf
# Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
# See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.
import ...gen.providers.tfe as tfe
class MyConvertedCode(cdktf.TerraformStack):
    def __init__(self, scope, name):
        super().__init__(scope, name)
        tfe.data_tfe_registry_gpg_keys.DataTfeRegistryGpgKeys(self, "all",
            organization="my-org-name"
        )
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Name of the organization for use as an ID.
- `keys` (Attributes List) List of GPG keys in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `ascii_armor` (String) ASCII-armored representation of the GPG key.
- `created_at` (String) The time when the GPG key was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the GPG key.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.
- `updated_at` (String) The time when the GPG key was last updated.
